stem.text: The graph shows the non-linear force–extension curve for a wire made from a new composite material.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled F/N, marked 100 and 0, and horizontal axis labelled x/mm, marked 0, 1.0 and 2.0; a curve rises from the origin, curving to a point labelled P, with dashed lines from 100 on the vertical axis and from 2.0 on the horizontal axis to P.

stem.text: What is the best estimate of the work done in stretching the wire to point P?
